## 4.2.4 (HexGhoul): the talk's rules: no more spamming one option, "who are you" asked once, one-time options

HexKagune 4.2.4 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (129).

You said (quoted exactly): "Okay, now we just need, now that the banjo is here, and I think that it's finally fixed. Um, Let's add more dialogue
to the gas mask leader, banjo, to the circus grill, more dialogue options. Um, Like overall, more talk, just more to be more interactive, more
opportunities to gain relationship. Let's develop this even further. So add as much text as you can to every single NPC, just some that can
increase relationship, um, some that reduce it. Currently, you can just spam one option and it'll give you relationship. It's a bug like that.
That shouldn't be able to pass. Plus, I don't know why you can ask twice the same person who they are. Like, I mean, if you're married to
someone, you can still ask them who the fuck they are. Like, how does that make sense? There should be such a thing as one-time options, like
one-time dialogue options. Like, this is getting a little ridiculous. I expect a little more dialogue on every single one of them. Um, So
develop every single NPC even further, add more dialogue, more options, all of them."

This version fixes the rules the new dialogue will run on. The new dialogue itself comes next, one version at a time: Banjou and Roma
(4.2.5), the General, Ayato and Noro (4.2.6), Eto, Touka and Ken (4.2.7), and the wild ghouls, gang members and village humans (4.2.8).

**The spam:** handing Roma or Banjou dinner (Ghoul Meat) gave +3 on every click, and the meat was never taken. Teasing anyone you're with
gave +1 a click, a kiss while they're half asleep +1 a click, and so on. Now every option on someone's first page pays its relationship
**once a day**, whatever it is: a tease, dinner, a home, an apology, a reassurance, the cookbook. Things that hurt (an insult) always hurt.
Roma and Banjou now take the meat from your hand and count it as the day's gift, like everyone else. Wild ghouls and gang members are warmed
by meat once a day too (they still eat more if you give it). The topics already paid once a day each; that's kept, and the old limit of 14
topics per person is gone (the 15th and later all shared one mark), so the new dialogue has room.

**"Who are you?":** asked once. It's never offered to someone you're dating or married to, even if you never asked. Wild ghouls and gang
members offered it every time; now once.

**One-time options:** a topic or a reply can now be one-time. Once said, it's gone for good (a question answered, a confession, a promise).
The new dialogue uses this.
